notes.title: The DROP 1st Birthday is here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42439053/ddc8cd5d31ff2a46a62d2388fe840c5646fb9c59.jpg[/img]

Hi DROP fans!

Today marks the first birthday of DROP!

That’s right it’s already been a year, feels like yesterday we started hacking the system to get rich while weaving & dodging the ongoing power struggle between corporations and factions to control the fragmented networks in the city.

To celebrate we want to see who can top the speedrun leaderboard and get your tips and tricks to help newbies get into the game.  

Check out the video Frazer has put together
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VgYZ2ZK513U

You can check out the top completion times here:

Don't forget to post your tips!  
[url=https://discord.gg/yF6qRWMZ]Head over to the Drop Discord [/url]

notes.title: Nominate DROP - System Breach for a Steam Award!
notes.content:
Hacking in DROP is an adrenaline-rush affair. It wouldn’t be as fun and exciting without its incredible soundtrack.

Jump from node to node while you carefully watch the timer and consider the quickest path to the final objective; the addictive soundtrack pushes you to the limit.

If you want to help the game’s visibility while acknowledging the amazing work done on the soundtrack please consider nominating DROP - System Breach for the Best Soundtrack!

Go with the rhythm!

notes.title: DROP - System Breach Build 1362
notes.content:
The patch fixes a bug on the "Gnosys - Clear Infection" level. If the player stopped both infections but gave up the level, the map view hung for a few seconds.

Also, we modified the "Noise Matrix / Noise Disturbances 1" Guide to being more precise: "However, manual navigation will be required. As a side effect of the disturbance, you cannot jump to the HUB occupied by the Noise Program with the Hostile and even Friendly Program Iterator. You can find and kill it in the traditional, slower way."

notes.title: DROP - System Breach Build 1358
notes.content: Localization fix: we gave the Communication Controller a more recognizable name in the mission objective text.

notes.title: DROP - System Breach Build 1356
notes.content: The patch fixes a small bug where a secondary objective asks for 0/0 Market Data, and no Market Data is on the map. This bug only affects one level. The secondary objective has been changed to: Avoid Direct Hit.

notes.title: DROP - System Breach April Update
notes.content:
Here's the summary of the April Update:

Accessibility: 
It can be a bit harder to see the difference between the elements of the Proxy Gateway minigame for some players. We fix it by putting small icons on those elements.

Easy read mode:
Some players found the screen effects overwhelming.
We introduce a new menu element that allows the players to turn the easy-read mode on, turning off some effects.

Updated level sequence:
The player can continue the game after they finish the story with additional procedurally generated levels.

Minor Bug Fixes:
- Fixed a bug that prevented the user to get to the game over screen if he was in a shocked or locked state.
- Fixed a few levels where the game didn't generate enough target accounts to be able to complete certain objectives.
- Fixed minor localization typos.
- Fixed the issue of the settings not being saved correctly.

notes.title: DROP - System Breach is live on Steam
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=5SVGJJeFHl4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1] Welcome to the cold, disconnected future! [/h1]

There is no public network here. All organizations, companies, and communities have built their digital fortresses to protect their data from everyone else.
You are trying to prove yourself as a hacker in this world.
It's dangerous, but you can succeed if you get them what they need.
You undertake DROPs: connect to local terminals with your cyberdeck, break into networks, download valuable information, install spyware, or support physical intrusions from the background.
And if you're smart, you'll disappear without leaving a trace.
But you have to hurry because you only have five minutes before you get caught.
That's what every single Drop is about.
It is about the constant danger.
But if you skillfully maneuver in this game, you can achieve anything. 
Drop is a unique hacker simulator. It combines some aspects of action and strategy games, reflex games, and puzzle games to reproduce the classic cyberpunk genre's fast-paced and spectacular hacking scenes.
Success requires speed, intuition, a sense of strategy, and intense player knowledge.
But if you've built the right deck from the hardware and software you have and have a feel for the flow, you'll feel like a real big shot.
You will explore the network, run programs, and zigzag between attacks from enemy systems as the clock ticks to zero.
As your firewall slowly crumbles and the screeching of your deck's distress signal tries to make you see better, you still want to get to the end of something.
You still need those last few bits of data before they reveal your position.
If you're outstanding, you can do it.
Again, and again, and again.

notes.title: DROP Steam Next Fest Stream
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42439053/6259fdb2c129ade67f86f68e66cf34ff0f61f724.png[/img]

We are broadcasting a playthrough of our demo.
It is 1 hour long and shows all the game's features.

Feel free to comment in the Discussion Forum or on Discord!

Forum: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1902300/discussions/]LINK[/url]

Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/microprose-official-681523353651249174]LINK[/url]

The future is cold, disconnected, and paranoid. The world has recoiled and fractured into countless digital enclaves and virtual fortresses in an era of digital isolation, suspicion, and espionage. In this world, there’s only one truth: hackers get fame, money, and dead if they’re not careful. 

You are a promising hacker with huge ambitions, an empty bank account, and the burning desire to prove yourself. When your actions attract the attention of a notorious hacker group, The Swarm, life gets complicated - real quick. 

Your world turns upside-down when simple jobs hurl you into a power struggle between The Swarm, different factions, and megacorporations that could decide the fate of the world’s fragmented networks. Use your cunning, stealth, and prowess to stay ahead of what lurks around the next node.

[h2][b]Key features[/b][/h2]
Drop is a fast-paced rogue-like hacking simulator with unique visuals and electronic soundscapes that evoke the thrill of hacking.
Hack networks to gain respect and notoriety within the community.
Find solutions to a myriad of complex puzzles.
Work against time, firewalls, and other nerve-racking hazards to get paid.
Procedurally generated side quests offer unlimited playtime.
Play an unfolding story campaign through unique missions. Explore the opportunities offered by the numerous factions with their agendas and assignments.
Intense gameplay is controlled through an elegantly-simple keyboard or gamepad configuration.

notes.title: MicroProse announces 5 New Games!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37756818/055da8dbdf3255b96d5ace29fbbd4e12efa62d16.jpg[/img]

Hello MicroProse fans!
We are back at announcing new games that join our line-up. This time it's all about stories, atmosphere, exploration, but also intrigue and even sport!

Let's take a look at each one of them.

[h1][b]Neyyah[/b][/h1]
Neyyah is a first-person [b]point-and-click adventure[/b] game from solo developer, Aaron Gwynaire.
You are thrown into a strange secretive world called Neyyah. Use careful observation and logic to uncover the mysteries entwined within Neyyah's peculiar landscapes and bizarre cultures.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37756818/de8135a673b6143005c795f6e183850cd8986f25.jpg[/img]

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37756818/39ebb57779f238c975c92b6ac1118d57504a9cef.jpg[/img]

Neyyah is set within a collection of remote almost abandoned islands, separated by a series of complex portal machinery and laced with the fingerprints of two very intriguing cultures.
Upon waking up from a strange dream, you find yourself transported to a place called Olujay, where you meet Vamir, who sends you to Neyyah in the hope you will be safe there. For reasons you will discover upon your many explorations, Vamir needs you for a matter of great urgency.

[i]A wrong must be righted. A civilization avenged. A secret revealed.[/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1289720/

[h1][b]Let Bions Be Bygones[/b][/h1]
[i]"Welcome to the planet Terrahive. A planet that never should have existed. Completely encrusted in a disease called humanity. Corporate arcologies and space elevators shadow the layers of polluted man-made edifices. Overseen by ancient brains on apparatuses and driven by greed, corruption, progress, and immortality." [/i]- John Cooper

Let Bions be Bygones is an [b]atmospheric narrative future-noir thriller.[/b]

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37756818/b8a3cf3f6b0f28de942468b7b30d5e7d4cd3c5ff.jpg[/img]

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37756818/a107fc4637a785d041ab6f24ca69c3a3aa07515f.jpg[/img]

A new take on the classic genre, Let Bions be Bygones, lets the players focus on the [b]story[/b], [b]narrative[/b], and [b]detective work[/b].  Players will be able to choose their own path and grow their characters through different playstyles.
All this and more, in a gritty world captivated by an original, unique soundtrack and a professional voice-over that will immerse the player in a thrilling tale with multiple endings.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1347560/

[h1][b]CrossOver: Roll for Initiative[/b][/h1]

CrossOver is a [b]tabletop RPG strategy[/b] game.
Defend your tabletop RPG paper character sheet from invading pixel enemies! Find matches in your tray of dice to power attacks to clear the evil from your shelf full of campaign books. Hardcore match-3 RPG puzzle meets action-strategy tower defence.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37756818/b0ba7db416383b0d3b2b1b683567d52a1a52acea.jpg[/img][img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37756818/474a4ea83cc8961bac62b6c123dcef92e9a282eb.jpg[/img]

CrossOver takes some classic concepts from traditionally “casual” genres (Match 3 and Tower Defence) and crosses them into a new and eccentric hardcore challenge with [b]Strategy, RPG and Puzzle elements.[/b]

The main campaigns include RPG progression, dozens of spells and weapons to find, mercenaries to hire, and shops to buy armor and items. Random encounters appear between stages with Fighting Fantasy book style choices. Earn persistent gems to unlock more classes/races (15 of each in the game) or trade in for extra gold during any campaign.
Try your hand at the [b]Solo [/b]and [b]Co-Op Endless Modes[/b] to challenge the Online Leaderboards!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1713080/

[h1][b]Drop[/b][/h1]
DROP is a rogue-like [b]hacking simulator[/b] set in a fragmented future.
You are a freelancer, trying to gain fame in DROP, an anonymous system for hackers. You break into digital enclaves and leave without a trace, but you find yourself in a conflict between various agencies that could change the world.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37756818/06ea7e67a38903c2b0e3d6cc821293dec5132b7c.jpg[/img]
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37756818/2fea9c67c8a40a3ebac24b9f51129817292d33a6.jpg[/img]

Enter a disconnected cyberpunk world – the unique visuals, exclusive soundtrack, and electronic soundscapes evoke the feel and the thrill of hacking in a potential future. Play an unfolding story campaign through unique missions.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1902300/

[h1][b]Tiny Football[/b][/h1]

[i]Tackle, Pass and Shoot your way to the back of the net.
On the Couch or Online. Settle old scores![/i]

Tiny Football is a throwback to old [b]top-down retro soccer games of the 90s.[/b] Master the art of passing and shooting, tackles, crosses, throw balls, overhead kicks, free kicks, and more. Compete with 64 national and club teams in a variety of tournaments.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37756818/b87e7dcabe43e485438b59d10c5a254572b4632e.jpg[/img]
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37756818/d12fe24f8de97acca6ea04f9473680bce92c36cc.jpg[/img]

Rich gameplay and real challenge is achieved by sharing user control with AI assistance to produce passing and shooting based on individual player ability.
Each squad member has their own skill levels and players can be pre-selected before a match and substituted during a match when they are tired.
In-match injuries will force substitutions. Sent off players and player suspensions will force players to shuffle team selection adding a managerial feel to tournaments.

Additional features include goal celebrations, player protests, extra time and penalties. Play with a friend (controller and keyboard) or the computer.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1887010/
